about_the_game:
Gamer Stop Simulator – Passion, Pixels, and Profit!

In Gamer Stop Simulator, you step into the dusty aisles of a forgotten shop with nothing but a small collection of old games, limited cash, and a passion for gaming. From humble beginnings, you’ll build and manage your very own video game store buying, fixing, pricing, and selling everything from retro classics to rare collectibles.

GROW FROM LOCAL NOBODY TO LEGENDARY SHOP

Host garage sales, take part in collector events, and decide your store’s future: will it be a massive marketplace, or a boutique museum of gaming history?

INTERACT WITH UNIQUE CUSTOMERS

Deal with collectors, bargain hunters, and nostalgic gamers. Some just want a cheap game, others bring in boxes of hidden gems for you to inspect. Negotiate hard or miss out on rare finds.

REPAIR & DIAGNOSE SYSTEMS

Use your diagnostic tools to find and fix hardware issues. As your skills grow, you’ll identify deeper problems, lower repair costs, and boost resale value. Everything from cosmetic damage to deep internal failures awaits your expertise.

MANAGE YOUR SHOP LIKE A PRO

Open and close your store manually. Clean, organize, and decorate your space to attract more customers. Expand your business, unlock new areas like repair zones or testing stations, and customize your store layout.

Core Gameplay Mechanics

  • Shop Management

  • Inventory and Product Management

  • Customer Interaction

  • Negotiation and Pricing System

  • Repair and Testing Mechanics

  • Financial Operations and Expense Tracking

  • Decoration and Store Expansion

short_description: Gamer Stop Simulator is a simulation game where you manage a video game store. Buy games and consoles from customers, repair broken devices, test games, and add rare items to your collection. Negotiate prices, expand your store, and grow your business in this exciting retail experience!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian
